newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- S. Barney confirms Vons cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- S. Barney confirms Vons cut.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Gary Giblen said he downgraded Von Cos Inc to neutral from buy "strictly for mechanical reasons" due to the limited arbitrage possible in the spread between Von's closing price Thursday and Safeway Inc's bid.

-- In published comments, he said that Safeway's offer of 1.34 shares for every Von share carries an implied value of $57.45 for each Von share, leaving only a modest arbitrage opportunity compared to its close of $55-3/8 Thursday.
